Name: Morning Dew Mod Manager
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Morning Dew[/b][/size] [size=4]A simple, fast mod manager for Stardew Valley[/size]
[line]
[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size] Morning Dew shows every mod in your Mods folder with a checkbox. Tick it to turn a mod on, untick it to turn it off. No file editing, no folder juggling. It checks your mods for problems before you start the game and explains them in plain English. Turning a mod off adds a "." to the start of its folder name, which SMAPI ignores. It's instant and nothing is moved or deleted. Turning it on removes the ".". [size=4][b]The three things it is built around[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Load order:[/b] The [i]Loading order[/i] window shows the order SMAPI will load your mods in and which mods it will skip, and why: missing or outdated requirements, duplicate IDs, or loops. It is a preview only. Morning Dew never renames your folders to force an order, because SMAPI sorts them itself. [/*]
[*][b]Conflict finder:[/b] Finds duplicate UniqueIDs (SMAPI loads none of the copies), missing or outdated requirements, and Content Patcher packs that change the same thing. It reads your config.json and HasMod conditions, so patches for different seasons, weather or languages are not reported as clashes. [/*]
[*][b]Easy to use:[/b] Checkboxes, search, filters, a built-in tour and plain-language messages. You never have to touch a path or a code file. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Mod sets:[/b] Save the mods you have on as a named set and switch between them. A set remembers the exact copy of each mod. After loading one, Morning Dew lists what was turned on or off and checks the result against your folder. [/*]
[*][b]Add mods from .zip:[/b] Drag a zip onto the window or use "Add mod (zip)…". Unsafe zips are refused, upgrades keep your config.json, and the old copy is set aside, not deleted. [/*]
[*][b]Health check:[/b] Finds missing requirements, duplicate mods, outdated requirements, and mods that can't load because something they need can't load. [/*]
[*][b]Updates window:[/b] Shows each mod's installed version, the latest version and a plain status. It works instantly from SMAPI's own report in your last log. You can also refresh it online from smapi.io, and optionally from Nexus with your own key. [/*]
[*][b]Game log helper:[/b] Reads SMAPI's last log and explains which mods were skipped and what the errors mean. Repeated errors are grouped. [i]Copy summary[/i] gives you text for a help request. [/*]
[*][b]Tidy up:[/b] Finds duplicate mods, leftover zips and empty folders. Nothing is deleted. Items go to a "Morning Dew Removed" folder and can be put back. [/*]
[*][b]Play button[/b] to start SMAPI, plus Delete mod (to the Recycle Bin), search, filters, sortable columns and a right-click menu. [/*]
[*][b]Shortcuts:[/b] Ctrl+F search, F5 refresh, Esc clear search, Space turn the selected mod on/off, Delete remove it. [/*]
[*][b]Remembers[/b] your window size, position and sort order. [/*]
[*][b]Copy diagnostics:[/b] A report for help requests. Your Nexus key is never included and your Windows user name is masked. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Themes[/b][/size] Dark, Light, Halloween, Pastel, [b]Junimo[/b] (soft meadow greens with drifting leaves) and [b]Starlight[/b] (night sky with twinkling and shooting stars). [size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size] English, Español, Français, Deutsch and Português (Brasil). The translations were written by an AI, not a native speaker, so some wording may be awkward. To add or fix a language, put a .json file in [i]%AppData%\MorningDew\Languages[/i]. English text is the key, and anything missing stays in English. [size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit [/*]
[*]Stardew Valley with SMAPI installed [/*]
[*]Nothing else. The download is a single .exe and needs no installer [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download MorningDew.exe and put it anywhere (the Desktop is fine). [/*]
[*]Close Stardew Valley and SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Run it. It looks for your Mods folder automatically. If it can't find it, it asks you to pick it. [/*]
[*]Press [i]How to use[/i] for a one-minute tour. [/*]
[/list]Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unrecognized app, since the exe is not code-signed. Choose [i]More info[/i], then [i]Run anyway[/i]. [size=4][b]Privacy[/b][/size] Morning Dew works fully offline. The only online features are the optional update checks, which ask for your permission first and contact smapi.io (and Nexus Mods, only if you add your own key). Your key is sent only to Nexus Mods. Settings are stored in [i]%AppData%\MorningDew[/i]. [size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Close Stardew Valley before changing mods. [/*]
[*]Update checks and the Nexus search link are best-effort. Answers depend on what smapi.io and Nexus return. [/*]
[*]Your Nexus key is saved as plain text in the settings file. Don't share that file. [/*]
[*].rar and .7z files can't be opened yet. Morning Dew tells you to unzip them first. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size] Delete MorningDew.exe. To remove its settings too, delete the [i]%AppData%\MorningDew[/i] folder. Your mods are never changed except for the "." in front of the folder names of mods you turned off. [size=4][b]Bugs and help[/b][/size] If something goes wrong, press [i]Copy diagnostics[/i] and paste the result in the comments or a bug report, along with what you were doing. [/center]
